name: Catbalogan Watershed Forest Reserve
nameStatus: Real study-area context: the reserve boundary is real GIS (Proclamation No. 413, s. 1994). The 3D terrain, rivers, reservoir, pumps, roads and service areas are a schematic simulation and do not depict the reserve's actual terrain or infrastructure.

operationalCatchment.note: The reserve boundary is never the operational catchment. Phase 2B derives a candidate catchment from the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM for an unverified DEM outlet near the published Kulador Treatment Plant coordinate (the actual intake / spillway location is not verified); the runoff model uses its area only if data/gis/catchments/operational_catchment.metadata.json is "validated" with every check passed, otherwise the simulated 0.30 km².

_howToSupplyData: 1. Save the verified watershed (or contributing-catchment) polygon as data/gis/watershed_boundary.geojson (Polygon or MultiPolygon).
2. Fill in data/gis/metadata.json: status, boundaryType, source, sourceUrl, dataset, feature, retrieved, originalCrs, geometryType, areaKm2, notes.

4. Only status "verified" + boundaryType "contributing-catchment" replaces the simulated operational catchment. A "watershed" or "watershed-management-context" boundary is shown as study-area context only.
5. Administrative polygons (municipality, barangay) belong under gis.administrative and are never used as a watershed.
